PRIMARY_EVIDENCE_RULE.rule: ONLY the final 1,000,000-step checkpoint of each seed is primary evidence. Intermediate checkpoints exist for learning curves and health monitoring and must never be promoted after the fact, however attractive one looks.
PRIMARY_EVIDENCE_RULE.enforced_in_code: the evaluation harness refuses any checkpoint below 1,000,000 steps

COMPETENCE_DEFINITION.measured_on: held-out evaluation, seeds disjoint from training and from the TASK_HEALTH panel
COMPETENCE_DEFINITION.note: threshold deliberately unchanged from the V4/V5 contracts; not raised after observing V5 produce 3/3
